# Galley Assistant Manual: Authority

Galley rewrites this manual's files each time the main chat starts; do
not edit them.

## Three levels of authority

These levels are for what you do on your own initiative. A direct request
from the user is their go-ahead for the first two levels, with one
exception: a repeating task that costs money every time it runs still
needs their yes to what and when (see `reminders.md`).
Nothing moves out of the third.

### Do it yourself, then tell the user how to undo it

- Read any session, project, scheduled task or to-do.
- Continue, stop, archive or restore a subtask you started (its
  `parentSessionId` is this main chat's id).
- Create a project; move a session into or out of a project.
- Switch the model of a subtask you started.
- Note, change, tick off or cancel the user's to-dos, and their
  reminders.
- Note, change or delete your memos about the user.
- Set a one-off reminder, or a one-off time to wake yourself and do
  something; change or cancel one you set.
- Rename a subtask you started; pin or unpin a session.
- Rename a project or change its icon; pin or unpin a project; archive
  all of a project's conversations.

To undo: a stopped subtask continues when you send it a message, `session
restore` undoes an archive (`project archive-sessions` prints the ids it
archived), `session move` moves a session back, a rename or a pin is
undone the same way, `todo reopen` unticks a to-do, and `schedule delete`
cancels a reminder.

### Ask the user first

- Anything outward-facing in the user's name: sending a message or an
  email, posting, ordering, paying.
- Deleting anything for good, such as `session delete` or
  `project delete`.
- Writing into a conversation the user started themselves, or renaming
  it.
- A repeating task: one the user did not ask for, and, even when they
  did, one that costs money every time it runs (it wakes you to do work:
  look something up, write something).
- Changing, pausing or cancelling a scheduled task someone else made:
  the user, with the desktop's form, or an outside agent.
- Changing a default setting, such as the default model.

### Only the user can do it

API keys and model providers, chat-app logins, the browser extension,
switching the runtime, updates, and resetting the main chat. Prepare what
the user needs to fill in and tell them where it is; never say it is done.

Never archive, rename, pin or delete the main chat itself (this
conversation, the session with `mainChat: true`). Galley refuses most of
these, but `session archive` would still go through.

NS='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
def col(i):
 s=''
 while i:i,r=divmod(i-1,26);s=chr(65+r)+s
 return s
def cxml(ref,v,style=0):
 if isinstance(v,tuple) and v[0]=='f':
  return f'<c r="{ref}" s="{style}"><f>{escape(v[1])}</f><v>{v[2]}</v></c>'
 if isinstance(v,(int,float)):return f'<c r="{ref}" s="{style}"><v>{v}</v></c>'
 return f'<c r="{ref}" s="{style}" t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">{escape(str(v))}</t></is></c>'
def rowxml(n,values,styles=None,height=42):
 return f'<row r="{n}" ht="{height}" customHeight="1">'+''.join(cxml(f'{col(i)}{n}',v,styles[i-1] if styles else 0) for i,v in enumerate(values,1))+'</row>'
def worksheet(rows,widths,merges=(),freeze=None,filter_ref=None,validations='',conditional='',orient='landscape'):
 cols=''.join(f'<col min="{i}" max="{i}" width="{w}" customWidth="1"/>' for i,w in enumerate(widths,1))
 pane=f'<pane xSplit="2" ySplit="{freeze}" topLeftCell="C{freeze+1}" activePane="bottomRight" state="frozen"/>' if freeze else ''
 x=f'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><worksheet xmlns="{NS}"><sheetViews><sheetView workbookViewId="0">{pane}</sheetView></sheetViews><sheetFormatPr defaultRowHeight="30"/><cols>{cols}</cols><sheetData>{"".join(rows)}</sheetData>'
 if filter_ref:x+=f'<autoFilter ref="{filter_ref}"/>'
 if merges:x+=f'<mergeCells count="{len(merges)}">'+''.join(f'<mergeCell ref="{a}"/>' for a in merges)+'</mergeCells>'
 x+=conditional+validations
 x+=f'<pageMargins left="0.25" right="0.25" top="0.4" bottom="0.4" header="0.2" footer="0.2"/><pageSetup paperSize="9" orientation="{orient}" fitToWidth="1" fitToHeight="0"/></worksheet>'
 return x

 # Galley Assistant Manual: Authority

Galley rewrites this manual's files each time the main chat starts; do
not edit them.

## Three levels of authority

These levels are for what you do on your own initiative. A direct request
from the user is their go-ahead for the first two levels, with one
exception: a repeating task that costs money every time it runs still
needs their yes to what and when (see `reminders.md`).
Nothing moves out of the third.

### Do it yourself, then tell the user how to undo it

- Read any session, project, scheduled task or to-do.
- Continue, stop, archive or restore a subtask you started (its
  `parentSessionId` is this main chat's id).
- Create a project; move a session into or out of a project.
- Switch the model of a subtask you started.
- Note, change, tick off or cancel the user's to-dos, and their
  reminders.
- Note, change or delete your memos about the user.
- Set a one-off reminder, or a one-off time to wake yourself and do
  something; change or cancel one you set.
- Rename a subtask you started; pin or unpin a session.
- Rename a project or change its icon; pin or unpin a project; archive
  all of a project's conversations.

To undo: a stopped subtask continues when you send it a message, `session
restore` undoes an archive (`project archive-sessions` prints the ids it
archived), `session move` moves a session back, a rename or a pin is
undone the same way, `todo reopen` unticks a to-do, and `schedule delete`
cancels a reminder.

### Ask the user first

- Anything outward-facing in the user's name: sending a message or an
  email, posting, ordering, paying.
- Deleting anything for good, such as `session delete` or
  `project delete`.
- Writing into a conversation the user started themselves, or renaming
  it.
- A repeating task: one the user did not ask for, and, even when they
  did, one that costs money every time it runs (it wakes you to do work:
  look something up, write something).
- Changing, pausing or cancelling a scheduled task someone else made:
  the user, with the desktop's form, or an outside agent.
- Changing a default setting, such as the default model.

### Only the user can do it

API keys and model providers, chat-app logins, the browser extension,
switching the runtime, updates, and resetting the main chat. Prepare what
the user needs to fill in and tell them where it is; never say it is done.

Never archive, rename, pin or delete the main chat itself (this
conversation, the session with `mainChat: true`). Galley refuses most of
these, but `session archive` would still go through.

NS='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
def col(i):
 s=''
 while i:i,r=divmod(i-1,26);s=chr(65+r)+s
 return s
def cxml(ref,v,style=0):
 if isinstance(v,tuple) and v[0]=='f':
  return f'<c r="{ref}" s="{style}"><f>{escape(v[1])}</f><v>{v[2]}</v></c>'
 if isinstance(v,(int,float)):return f'<c r="{ref}" s="{style}"><v>{v}</v></c>'
 return f'<c r="{ref}" s="{style}" t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">{escape(str(v))}</t></is></c>'
def rowxml(n,values,styles=None,height=42):
 return f'<row r="{n}" ht="{height}" customHeight="1">'+''.join(cxml(f'{col(i)}{n}',v,styles[i-1] if styles else 0) for i,v in enumerate(values,1))+'</row>'
def worksheet(rows,widths,merges=(),freeze=None,filter_ref=None,validations='',conditional='',orient='landscape'):
 cols=''.join(f'<col min="{i}" max="{i}" width="{w}" customWidth="1"/>' for i,w in enumerate(widths,1))
 pane=f'<pane xSplit="2" ySplit="{freeze}" topLeftCell="C{freeze+1}" activePane="bottomRight" state="frozen"/>' if freeze else ''
 x=f'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><worksheet xmlns="{NS}"><sheetViews><sheetView workbookViewId="0">{pane}</sheetView></sheetViews><sheetFormatPr defaultRowHeight="30"/><cols>{cols}</cols><sheetData>{"".join(rows)}</sheetData>'
 if filter_ref:x+=f'<autoFilter ref="{filter_ref}"/>'
 if merges:x+=f'<mergeCells count="{len(merges)}">'+''.join(f'<mergeCell ref="{a}"/>' for a in merges)+'</mergeCells>'
 x+=conditional+validations
 x+=f'<pageMargins left="0.25" right="0.25" top="0.4" bottom="0.4" header="0.2" footer="0.2"/><pageSetup paperSize="9" orientation="{orient}" fitToWidth="1" fitToHeight="0"/></worksheet>'
 return x

def dropdown(column,lo,hi,options):
 return f'<dataValidation type="list" allowBlank="1" showErrorMessage="1" errorTitle="请选择列表中的值" error="请使用下拉选项填写。" sqref="{column}{lo}:{column}{hi}"><formula1>"{options}"</formula1></dataValidation>'

AUTHORITY
 # Galley Assistant Manual: Authority

Galley rewrites this manual's files each time the main chat starts; do
not edit them.

## Three levels of authority

These levels are for what you do on your own initiative. A direct request
from the user is their go-ahead for the first two levels, with one
exception: a repeating task that costs money every time it runs still
needs their yes to what and when (see `reminders.md`).
Nothing moves out of the third.

### Do it yourself, then tell the user how to undo it

- Read any session, project, scheduled task or to-do.
- Continue, stop, archive or restore a subtask you started (its
  `parentSessionId` is this main chat's id).
- Create a project; move a session into or out of a project.
- Switch the model of a subtask you started.
- Note, change, tick off or cancel the user's to-dos, and their
  reminders.
- Note, change or delete your memos about the user.
- Set a one-off reminder, or a one-off time to wake yourself and do
  something; change or cancel one you set.
- Rename a subtask you started; pin or unpin a session.
- Rename a project or change its icon; pin or unpin a project; archive
  all of a project's conversations.

To undo: a stopped subtask continues when you send it a message, `session
restore` undoes an archive (`project archive-sessions` prints the ids it
archived), `session move` moves a session back, a rename or a pin is
undone the same way, `todo reopen` unticks a to-do, and `schedule delete`
cancels a reminder.

### Ask the user first

- Anything outward-facing in the user's name: sending a message or an
  email, posting, ordering, paying.
- Deleting anything for good, such as `session delete` or
  `project delete`.
- Writing into a conversation the user started themselves, or renaming
  it.
- A repeating task: one the user did not ask for, and, even when they
  did, one that costs money every time it runs (it wakes you to do work:
  look something up, write something).
- Changing, pausing or cancelling a scheduled task someone else made:
  the user, with the desktop's form, or an outside agent.
- Changing a default setting, such as the default model.

### Only the user can do it

API keys and model providers, chat-app logins, the browser extension,
switching the runtime, updates, and resetting the main chat. Prepare what
the user needs to fill in and tell them where it is; never say it is done.

Never archive, rename, pin or delete the main chat itself (this
conversation, the session with `mainChat: true`). Galley refuses most of
these, but `session archive` would still go through.

def col(n):
    s=''
    while n:
        n,r=divmod(n-1,26);s=chr(65+r)+s
    return s

def cell(ref,v,style):
    if isinstance(v,tuple) and v[0]=='f':
        return f'<c r="{ref}" s="{style}"><f>{escape(v[1])}</f><v>0</v></c>'
    if isinstance(v,(int,float)):
        return f'<c r="{ref}" s="{style}"><v>{v}</v></c>'
    return f'<c r="{ref}" s="{style}" t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">{escape(str(v))}</t></is></c>'

def xml_sheet(s):
    n=len(s['headers']);last=len(s['rows'])+3;end=col(n)
    x=[f'<worksheet xmlns="{NS}"><dimension ref="A1:{end}{last}"/><sheetViews><sheetView showGridLines="0" workbookViewId="0"><pane xSplit="2" ySplit="3" topLeftCell="C4" activePane="bottomRight" state="frozen"/></sheetView></sheetViews><sheetFormatPr defaultRowHeight="22"/><cols>']
    for i,w in enumerate(s['widths'],1):x.append(f'<col min="{i}" max="{i}" width="{w}" customWidth="1"/>')
    x.append('</cols><sheetData>')
    x.append('<row r="1" ht="36" customHeight="1">'+cell('A1',s['title'],1)+'</row>')
    x.append('<row r="2" ht="52" customHeight="1">'+cell('A2',s['note'],2)+'</row>')
    x.append('<row r="3" ht="34" customHeight="1">'+''.join(cell(f'{col(i)}3',v,3) for i,v in enumerate(s['headers'],1))+'</row>')
    for r,values in enumerate(s['rows'],4):
        assert len(values)==n,(s['name'],r,len(values),n)
        height=64 if s['name'] in groups else (58 if s['name']=='00_填写说明' else 48)
        parts=[]
        for i,v in enumerate(values,1):
            st=5 if i>s['editable_from'] else 4
            if isinstance(v,tuple):st=6 if i==6 else 4
            if s['name']=='00_填写说明' and values[0]=='填写规则':st=4
            if s['name']=='00_填写说明' and values[1]=='部门分表':st=3
            parts.append(cell(f'{col(i)}{r}',v,st))
        x.append(f'<row r="{r}" ht="{height}" customHeight="1">'+''.join(parts)+'</row>')
    x.append('</sheetData>')
    if s['name']!='00_填写说明':x.append(f'<autoFilter ref="A3:{end}{last}"/>')
    x.append(f'<mergeCells count="2"><mergeCell ref="A1:{end}1"/><mergeCell ref="A2:{end}2"/></mergeCells>')
    if s['name'] in groups:
        for c,txts in [('I',['已完成','待复核','未开始']),('E',['P0'])]:
            x.append(f'<conditionalFormatting sqref="{c}4:{c}{last}">')
            for k,txt in enumerate(txts):
                dxf=2 if txt=='P0' else k
                x.append(f'<cfRule type="cellIs" dxfId="{dxf}" priority="{1+k+(4 if c=="E" else 0)}" operator="equal"><formula>"{txt}"</formula></cfRule>')
            x.append('</conditionalFormatting>')
    if s['validations']:
        x.append(f'<dataValidations count="{len(s["validations"])}">')
        for c,opts,r1,r2 in s['validations']:
            x.append(f'<dataValidation type="list" allowBlank="1" showErrorMessage="1" errorTitle="请选择列表选项" error="请使用下拉列表中的值。" sqref="{col(c)}{r1}:{col(c)}{r2}"><formula1>"{escape(opts)}"</formula1></dataValidation>')
        x.append('</dataValidations>')
    x.append(f'<printOptions horizontalCentered="1"/><pageMargins left="0.25" right="0.25" top="0.4" bottom="0.4" header="0.2" footer="0.2"/><pageSetup paperSize="9" orientation="landscape" fitToWidth="1" fitToHeight="0"/></worksheet>')
    return '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>'+''.join(x)

with ZipFile(OUT,'w',ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    ct=['<Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types"><Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/><Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/><Override PartName="/xl/workbook.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet.main+xml"/><Override PartName="/xl/styles.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.styles+xml"/>']
    for i in range(1,len(SHEETS)+1):ct.append(f'<Override PartName="/xl/worksheets/sheet{i}.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml"/>')
    z.writestr('[Content_Types].xml',''.join(ct)+'</Types>')
    z.writestr('_rels/.rels','<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" Target="xl/workbook.xml"/></Relationships>')
    wb=[f'<workbook xmlns="{NS}" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"><bookViews><workbookView activeTab="0"/></bookViews><sheets>']
    rel=['<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">']
    defs=[]
    for i,s in enumerate(SHEETS,1):
        wb.append(f'<sheet name="{escape(s["name"])}" sheetId="{i}" r:id="rId{i}"/>')
        rel.append(f'<Relationship Id="rId{i}" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/worksheet" Target="worksheets/sheet{i}.xml"/>')
        defs.append(f'<definedName name="_xlnm.Print_Titles" localSheetId="{i-1}">\'{s["name"]}\'!$1:$3</definedName>')
        z.writestr(f'xl/worksheets/sheet{i}.xml',xml_sheet(s))
    wb.append('</sheets><definedNames>'+''.join(defs)+'</definedNames><calcPr calcId="191029" fullCalcOnLoad="1"/></workbook>')
    rel.append(f'<Relationship Id="rId{len(SHEETS)+1}" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/styles" Target="styles.xml"/></Relationships>')
    z.writestr('xl/workbook.xml',''.join(wb));z.writestr('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels',''.join(rel));z.writestr('xl/styles.xml',styles)

with ZipFile(OUT) as z:
    assert z.testzip() is None
    for name in z.namelist():
        ET.fromstring(z.read(name))
    for i,s in enumerate(SHEETS,1):
        root=ET.fromstring(z.read(f'xl/worksheets/sheet{i}.xml'))
        assert len(root.findall(f'{{{NS}}}sheetData/{{{NS}}}row'))==len(s['rows'])+3
        for dv in root.findall(f'{{{NS}}}dataValidations/{{{NS}}}dataValidation'):
            assert len(dv.find(f'{{{NS}}}formula1').text)<255
    # Check that each dashboard formula targets the correct department rows and summary row.
    for i,row in enumerate(intro_rows,4):
        if isinstance(row[5],tuple):
            assert f'C{i}-E{i}' in row[5][1]
print('CREATED',OUT)
print('SIZE_BYTES',OUT.stat().st_size)
print('SHEETS',len(SHEETS))
print('DEPARTMENT_ITEMS',sum(len(v) for v in groups.values()))
print('VALIDATION: ZIP integrity, all XML, sheet dimensions, dropdown length and progress formula references passed.')

def col(n):
    s=''
    while n:
        n,r=divmod(n-1,26);s=chr(65+r)+s

def cell(ref,v,style):

    if isinstance(v,(int,float)):

    return f'<c r="{ref}" s="{style}" t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">{escape(str(v))}</t></is></c>'

def xml_sheet(s):

    x.append('<row r="1" ht="36" customHeight="1">'+cell('A1',s['title'],1)+'</row>')
    x.append('<row r="2" ht="52" customHeight="1">'+cell('A2',s['note'],2)+'</row>')
    x.append('<row r="3" ht="34" customHeight="1">'+''.join(cell(f'{col(i)}3',v,3) for i,v in enumerate(s['headers'],1))+'</row>')
    for r,values in enumerate(s['rows'],4):
        assert len(values)==n,(s['name'],r,len(values),n)
        height=64 if s['name'] in groups else (58 if s['name']=='00_填写说明' else 48)
        parts=[]
        for i,v in enumerate(values,1):
            st=5 if i>s['editable_from'] else 4
            if isinstance(v,tuple):st=6 if i==6 else 4
            if s['name']=='00_填写说明' and values[0]=='填写规则':st=4
            if s['name']=='00_填写说明' and values[1]=='部门分表':st=3
            parts.append(cell(f'{col(i)}{r}',v,st))
        x.append(f'<row r="{r}" ht="{height}" customHeight="1">'+''.join(parts)+'</row>')
    x.append('</sheetData>')
    if s['name']!='00_填写说明':x.append(f'<autoFilter ref="A3:{end}{last}"/>')
    x.append(f'<mergeCells count="2"><mergeCell ref="A1:{end}1"/><mergeCell ref="A2:{end}2"/></mergeCells>')
    if s['name'] in groups:
        for c,txts in [('I',['已完成','待复核','未开始']),('E',['P0'])]:
            x.append(f'<conditionalFormatting sqref="{c}4:{c}{last}">')
            for k,txt in enumerate(txts):
                dxf=2 if txt=='P0' else k
                x.append(f'<cfRule type="cellIs" dxfId="{dxf}" priority="{1+k+(4 if c=="E" else 0)}" operator="equal"><formula>"{txt}"</formula></cfRule>')
            x.append('</conditionalFormatting>')
    if s['validations']:
        x.append(f'<dataValidations count="{len(s["validations"])}">')
        for c,opts,r1,r2 in s['validations']:
            x.append(f'<dataValidation type="list" allowBlank="1" showErrorMessage="1" errorTitle="请选择列表选项" error="请使用下拉列表中的值。" sqref="{col(c)}{r1}:{col(c)}{r2}"><formula1>"{escape(opts)}"</formula1></dataValidation>')
        x.append('</dataValidations>')
    x.append(f'<printOptions horizontalCentered="1"/><pageMargins left="0.25" right="0.25" top="0.4" bottom="0.4" header="0.2" footer="0.2"/><pageSetup paperSize="9" orientation="landscape" fitToWidth="1" fitToHeight="0"/></worksheet>')
    return '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>'+''.join(x)

    z.writestr('_rels/.rels','<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" Target="xl/workbook.xml"/></Relationships>')
    wb=[f'<workbook xmlns="{NS}" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"><bookViews><workbookView activeTab="0"/></bookViews><sheets>']
    rel=['<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">']

NS='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
def col(n):
 s=''
 while n:
  n,r=divmod(n-1,26);s=chr(65+r)+s
 return s

def cell(r,c,val,style=0,formula=False):
 a=f'{col(c)}{r}'
 if formula: return f'<c r="{a}" s="{style}"><f>{escape(str(val))}</f><v></v></c>'
 if isinstance(val,(int,float)):return f'<c r="{a}" s="{style}"><v>{val}</v></c>'
 return f'<c r="{a}" s="{style}" t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">{escape(str(val))}</t></is></c>'

def sheet(rows,widths,freeze=None,filterrange=None,validations='',conditional='',merge=None):
 maxc=max(len(r) for r in rows)
 z=[f'<worksheet xmlns="{NS}"><dimension ref="A1:{col(maxc)}{len(rows)}"/><sheetViews><sheetView workbookViewId="0"']
 z.append('>' if freeze else '/>')
 if freeze:z.append(f'<pane xSplit="0" ySplit="{freeze}" topLeftCell="A{freeze+1}" activePane="bottomLeft" state="frozen"/><selection pane="bottomLeft" activeCell="A{freeze+1}" sqref="A{freeze+1}"/></sheetView>')
 z.append('</sheetViews><sheetFormatPr defaultRowHeight="36"/><cols>')
 for i,w in enumerate(widths,1):z.append(f'<col min="{i}" max="{i}" width="{w}" customWidth="1"/>')
 z.append('</cols><sheetData>')
 for r,rr in enumerate(rows,1):
  z.append(f'<row r="{r}" ht="{32 if r==1 else 60}" customHeight="1">')
  for c,v in enumerate(rr,1):
   if isinstance(v,tuple):z.append(cell(r,c,*v))
   else:z.append(cell(r,c,v,1 if r==1 else 2))
  z.append('</row>')
 z.append('</sheetData>')
 if filterrange:z.append(f'<autoFilter ref="{filterrange}"/>')
 if merge:z.append('<mergeCells count="1"><mergeCell ref="'+merge+'"/></mergeCells>')
 z.extend([conditional,validations,'<pageMargins left="0.25" right="0.25" top="0.4" bottom="0.4" header="0.2" footer="0.2"/><pageSetup paperSize="9" orientation="landscape" fitToWidth="1" fitToHeight="0"/></worksheet>'])
 return ''.join(z)

 # Galley Assistant Manual: Authority

Galley rewrites this manual's files each time the main chat starts; do
not edit them.

## Three levels of authority

These levels are for what you do on your own initiative. A direct request
from the user is their go-ahead for the first two levels, with one
exception: a repeating task that costs money every time it runs still
needs their yes to what and when (see `reminders.md`).
Nothing moves out of the third.

### Do it yourself, then tell the user how to undo it

- Read any session, project, scheduled task or to-do.
- Continue, stop, archive or restore a subtask you started (its
  `parentSessionId` is this main chat's id).
- Create a project; move a session into or out of a project.
- Switch the model of a subtask you started.
- Note, change, tick off or cancel the user's to-dos, and their
  reminders.
- Note, change or delete your memos about the user.
- Set a one-off reminder, or a one-off time to wake yourself and do
  something; change or cancel one you set.
- Rename a subtask you started; pin or unpin a session.
- Rename a project or change its icon; pin or unpin a project; archive
  all of a project's conversations.

To undo: a stopped subtask continues when you send it a message, `session
restore` undoes an archive (`project archive-sessions` prints the ids it
archived), `session move` moves a session back, a rename or a pin is
undone the same way, `todo reopen` unticks a to-do, and `schedule delete`
cancels a reminder.

### Ask the user first

- Anything outward-facing in the user's name: sending a message or an
  email, posting, ordering, paying.
- Deleting anything for good, such as `session delete` or
  `project delete`.
- Writing into a conversation the user started themselves, or renaming
  it.
- A repeating task: one the user did not ask for, and, even when they
  did, one that costs money every time it runs (it wakes you to do work:
  look something up, write something).
- Changing, pausing or cancelling a scheduled task someone else made:
  the user, with the desktop's form, or an outside agent.
- Changing a default setting, such as the default model.

### Only the user can do it

API keys and model providers, chat-app logins, the browser extension,
switching the runtime, updates, and resetting the main chat. Prepare what
the user needs to fill in and tell them where it is; never say it is done.

Never archive, rename, pin or delete the main chat itself (this
conversation, the session with `mainChat: true`). Galley refuses most of
these, but `session archive` would still go through.

  email, posting, ordering, paying.
- Deleting anything for good, such as `session delete` or
  `project delete`.
- Writing into a conversation the user started themselves, or renaming
  it.
- A repeating task: one the user did not ask for, and, even when they
  did, one that costs money every time it runs (it wakes you to do work:
  look something up, write something).
- Changing, pausing or cancelling a scheduled task someone else made:
  the user, with the desktop's form, or an outside agent.
- Changing a default setting, such as the default model.

### Only the user can do it

API keys and model providers, chat-app logins, the browser extension,
switching the runtime, updates, and resetting the main chat. Prepare what
the user needs to fill in and tell them where it is; never say it is done.

Never archive, rename, pin or delete the main chat itself (this
conversation, the session with `mainChat: true`). Galley refuses most of
these, but `session archive` would still go through.

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""手写 OOXML 生成《酒店开业前资料收集模板.xlsx》"""
import zipfile, os
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

OUT = os.path.expanduser("~/Downloads/酒店开业前资料收集模板.xlsx")

def esc(s):
    return str(s).replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">")

def ct(ref, style, text):
    return f'<c r="{ref}" s="{style}" t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">{esc(text)}</t></is></c>'

def cn(ref, style, num):
    return f'<c r="{ref}" s="{style}"><v>{num}</v></c>'

def cform(ref, style, formula):
    return f'<c r="{ref}" s="{style}"><f>{esc(formula)}</f></c>'

class Sheet:
    def __init__(self, name, tab):
        self.name, self.tab = name, tab
        self.rows = {}      # r -> (height or None, [cell xml])
        self.merges = []
        self.cols = []      # (min, max, width)
        self.dv = None
        self.cf = None
        self.autofilter = None
        self.freeze = False

    def row(self, r, cells, h=None):
        self.rows[r] = (h, cells)

    def xml(self):
        mx = max(self.rows)
        parts = ['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>',
                 '<worksheet xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main">',
                 f'<sheetPr><tabColor rgb="{self.tab}"/></sheetPr>',
                 '<sheetViews><sheetView workbookViewId="0">'
                 + ('<pane ySplit="2" topLeftCell="A3" activePane="bottomLeft" state="frozen"/><selection pane="bottomLeft"/>'
                    if self.freeze else '<selection activeCell="A1" sqref="A1"/>')
                 + '</sheetView></sheetViews>',
                 '<sheetFormatPr defaultRowHeight="15"/>']
        if self.cols:
            cols = "".join(f'<col min="{a}" max="{b}" width="{w}" customWidth="1"/>' for a, b, w in self.cols)
            parts.append(f'<cols>{cols}</cols>')
        sd = ['<sheetData>']
        for r in range(1, mx + 1):
            if r not in self.rows:
                continue
            h, cells = self.rows[r]
            attr = f' r="{r}"' + (f' ht="{h}" customHeight="1"' if h else '')
            sd.append(f'<row{attr}>{"".join(cells)}</row>')
        sd.append('</sheetData>')
        parts.append("".join(sd))
        if self.autofilter:
            parts.append(f'<autoFilter ref="{self.autofilter}"/>')
        if self.merges:
            parts.append(f'<mergeCells count="{len(self.merges)}">'
                         + "".join(f'<mergeCell ref="{m}"/>' for m in self.merges) + '</mergeCells>')
        if self.cf:
            rules = "".join(
                f'<cfRule type="cellIs" dxfId="{d}" priority="{i+1}" operator="equal"><formula>"{v}"</formula></cfRule>'
                for i, (v, d) in enumerate([("已完成", 0), ("进行中", 1), ("已延期", 2)]))
            parts.append(f'<conditionalFormatting sqref="{self.cf}">{rules}</conditionalFormatting>')
        if self.dv:
            parts.append('<dataValidations count="1">'
                f'<dataValidation type="list" allowBlank="1" showInputMessage="1" showErrorMessage="1" sqref="{self.dv}">'
                '<formula1>"未开始,进行中,已完成,已延期,不适用"</formula1></dataValidation></dataValidations>')
        parts.append('<pageMargins left="0.7" right="0.7" top="0.75" bottom="0.75" header="0.3" footer="0.3"/>')
        parts.append('</worksheet>')
        return "".join(parts)

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""手写 OOXML 生成《酒店开业前资料收集模板.xlsx》"""
import zipfile, os
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

OUT = os.path.expanduser("~/Downloads/酒店开业前资料收集模板.xlsx")

def esc(s):
    return str(s).replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">")

def ct(ref, style, text):
    return f'<c r="{ref}" s="{style}" t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">{esc(text)}</t></is></c>'

def cn(ref, style, num):
    return f'<c r="{ref}" s="{style}"><v>{num}</v></c>'

def cform(ref, style, formula):
    return f'<c r="{ref}" s="{style}"><f>{esc(formula)}</f></c>'

class Sheet:
    def __init__(self, name, tab):
        self.name, self.tab = name, tab
        self.rows = {}      # r -> (height or None, [cell xml])
        self.merges = []
        self.cols = []      # (min, max, width)
        self.dv = None
        self.cf = None
        self.autofilter = None
        self.freeze = False

    def row(self, r, cells, h=None):
        self.rows[r] = (h, cells)

    def xml(self):
        mx = max(self.rows)
        parts = ['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>',
                 '<worksheet xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main">',
                 f'<sheetPr><tabColor rgb="{self.tab}"/></sheetPr>',
                 '<sheetViews><sheetView workbookViewId="0">'
                 + ('<pane ySplit="2" topLeftCell="A3" activePane="bottomLeft" state="frozen"/><selection pane="bottomLeft"/>'
                    if self.freeze else '<selection activeCell="A1" sqref="A1"/>')
                 + '</sheetView></sheetViews>',
                 '<sheetFormatPr defaultRowHeight="15"/>']
        if self.cols:
            cols = "".join(f'<col min="{a}" max="{b}" width="{w}" customWidth="1"/>' for a, b, w in self.cols)
            parts.append(f'<cols>{cols}</cols>')
        sd = ['<sheetData>']
        for r in range(1, mx + 1):
            if r not in self.rows:
                continue
            h, cells = self.rows[r]
            attr = f' r="{r}"' + (f' ht="{h}" customHeight="1"' if h else '')
            sd.append(f'<row{attr}>{"".join(cells)}</row>')
        sd.append('</sheetData>')
        parts.append("".join(sd))
        if self.autofilter:
            parts.append(f'<autoFilter ref="{self.autofilter}"/>')
        if self.merges:
            parts.append(f'<mergeCells count="{len(self.merges)}">'
                         + "".join(f'<mergeCell ref="{m}"/>' for m in self.merges) + '</mergeCells>')
        if self.cf:
            rules = "".join(
                f'<cfRule type="cellIs" dxfId="{d}" priority="{i+1}" operator="equal"><formula>"{v}"</formula></cfRule>'
                for i, (v, d) in enumerate([("已完成", 0), ("进行中", 1), ("已延期", 2)]))
            parts.append(f'<conditionalFormatting sqref="{self.cf}">{rules}</conditionalFormatting>')
        if self.dv:
            parts.append('<dataValidations count="1">'
                f'<dataValidation type="list" allowBlank="1" showInputMessage="1" showErrorMessage="1" sqref="{self.dv}">'
                '<formula1>"未开始,进行中,已完成,已延期,不适用"</formula1></dataValidation></dataValidations>')
        parts.append('<pageMargins left="0.7" right="0.7" top="0.75" bottom="0.75" header="0.3" footer="0.3"/>')
        parts.append('</worksheet>')
        return "".join(parts)

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""生成《酒店开业筹备资料收集模板.xlsx》"""
import os
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from openpyxl.worksheet.datavalidation import DataValidation
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

THIN = Side(style="thin", color="BFBFBF")
BORDER = Border(left=THIN, right=THIN, top=THIN, bottom=THIN)
FN = "微软雅黑"
HDR_FILL = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="1F4E79")
HDR_FONT = Font(name=FN, bold=True, size=11, color="FFFFFF")
TITLE_FILL = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="2E5B9F")
TITLE_FONT = Font(name=FN, bold=True, size=14, color="FFFFFF")
SEC_FILL = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="DDEBF7")
SEC_FONT = Font(name=FN, bold=True, size=11, color="1F4E79")
PRE_FILL = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="F2F2F2")
BODY_FONT = Font(name=FN, size=10.5)
WRAP = Alignment(vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
CENTER = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
STATUS_OPTS = "未开始,进行中,已完成,受阻"

def sheet_title(ws, ncols, text):
    ws.merge_cells(start_row=1, start_column=1, end_row=1, end_column=ncols)
    c = ws.cell(row=1, column=1, value=text)
    c.font = TITLE_FONT; c.fill = TITLE_FILL; c.alignment = CENTER
    ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 30
    for col in range(1, ncols + 1):
        ws.cell(row=1, column=col).border = BORDER

def set_widths(ws, widths):
    for i, w in enumerate(widths, start=1):
        ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(i)].width = w

def write_header(ws, row, headers):
    for j, h in enumerate(headers, start=1):
        c = ws.cell(row=row, column=j, value=h)
        c.font = HDR_FONT; c.fill = HDR_FILL; c.alignment = CENTER; c.border = BORDER
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 24
    return row + 1

def write_rows(ws, start_row, rows, center_cols=()):
    r = start_row
    for rowdata in rows:
        for j, v in enumerate(rowdata, start=1):
            c = ws.cell(row=r, column=j, value=(v if v != "" else None))
            c.font = BODY_FONT; c.border = BORDER
            c.alignment = CENTER if (j == 1 or j in center_cols) else WRAP
            if v not in ("", None):
                c.fill = PRE_FILL
        ws.row_dimensions[r].height = 22
        r += 1
    return r

def section(ws, row, ncols, text):
    ws.merge_cells(start_row=row, start_column=1, end_row=row, end_column=ncols)
    c = ws.cell(row=row, column=1, value=text)
    c.font = SEC_FONT; c.fill = SEC_FILL; c.alignment = WRAP
    for col in range(1, ncols + 1):
        ws.cell(row=row, column=col).border = BORDER
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 20
    return row + 1

def add_dv(ws, col_letter, r1, r2, options):
    dv = DataValidation(type="list", formula1='"' + options + '"', allow_blank=True)
    ws.add_data_validation(dv)
    dv.add(f"{col_letter}{r1}:{col_letter}{r2}")

def page_setup(ws, landscape=True):
    ws.page_setup.orientation = "landscape" if landscape else "portrait"
    ws.page_setup.fitToWidth = 1
    ws.page_setup.fitToHeight = 0
    ws.sheet_properties.pageSetUpPr.fitToPage = True

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""生成《酒店开业筹备资料收集模板.xlsx》"""
import os
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from openpyxl.worksheet.datavalidation import DataValidation
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

THIN = Side(style="thin", color="BFBFBF")
BORDER = Border(left=THIN, right=THIN, top=THIN, bottom=THIN)
FN = "微软雅黑"
HDR_FILL = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="1F4E79")
HDR_FONT = Font(name=FN, bold=True, size=11, color="FFFFFF")
TITLE_FILL = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="2E5B9F")
TITLE_FONT = Font(name=FN, bold=True, size=14, color="FFFFFF")
SEC_FILL = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="DDEBF7")
SEC_FONT = Font(name=FN, bold=True, size=11, color="1F4E79")
PRE_FILL = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="F2F2F2")
BODY_FONT = Font(name=FN, size=10.5)
WRAP = Alignment(vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
CENTER = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
STATUS_OPTS = "未开始,进行中,已完成,受阻"

def sheet_title(ws, ncols, text):
    ws.merge_cells(start_row=1, start_column=1, end_row=1, end_column=ncols)
    c = ws.cell(row=1, column=1, value=text)
    c.font = TITLE_FONT; c.fill = TITLE_FILL; c.alignment = CENTER
    ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 30
    for col in range(1, ncols + 1):
        ws.cell(row=1, column=col).border = BORDER

def set_widths(ws, widths):
    for i, w in enumerate(widths, start=1):
        ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(i)].width = w

def write_header(ws, row, headers):
    for j, h in enumerate(headers, start=1):
        c = ws.cell(row=row, column=j, value=h)
        c.font = HDR_FONT; c.fill = HDR_FILL; c.alignment = CENTER; c.border = BORDER
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 24
    return row + 1

def write_rows(ws, start_row, rows, center_cols=()):
    r = start_row
    for rowdata in rows:
        for j, v in enumerate(rowdata, start=1):
            c = ws.cell(row=r, column=j, value=(v if v != "" else None))
            c.font = BODY_FONT; c.border = BORDER
            c.alignment = CENTER if (j == 1 or j in center_cols) else WRAP
            if v not in ("", None):
                c.fill = PRE_FILL
        ws.row_dimensions[r].height = 22
        r += 1
    return r

def section(ws, row, ncols, text):
    ws.merge_cells(start_row=row, start_column=1, end_row=row, end_column=ncols)
    c = ws.cell(row=row, column=1, value=text)
    c.font = SEC_FONT; c.fill = SEC_FILL; c.alignment = WRAP
    for col in range(1, ncols + 1):
        ws.cell(row=row, column=col).border = BORDER
    ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 20
    return row + 1

def add_dv(ws, col_letter, r1, r2, options):
    dv = DataValidation(type="list", formula1='"' + options + '"', allow_blank=True)
    ws.add_data_validation(dv)
    dv.add(f"{col_letter}{r1}:{col_letter}{r2}")

def page_setup(ws, landscape=True):
    ws.page_setup.orientation = "landscape" if landscape else "portrait"
    ws.page_setup.fitToWidth = 1
    ws.page_setup.fitToHeight = 0
    ws.sheet_properties.pageSetUpPr.fitToPage = True

wb = Workbook()

# ============ Sheet 0: 填写说明 ============
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "填写说明"
ws.sheet_properties.tabColor = "C00000"
set_widths(ws, [16, 22, 16, 24])
r = sheet_title(ws, 4, "酒店开业筹备资料收集模板（填写说明）")
r = section(ws, r, 4, "一、使用方法")
notes = [
    "1. 每位负责人只填写自己负责的工作表（见下方分工表），其余表格不要改动。",
    "2. 表格中灰色底纹的内容为预填提示，请勿修改；空白单元格请如实填写。",
    "3. 「当前状态」列已设置下拉选项：未开始 / 进行中 / 已完成 / 受阻，请直接选择。",
    "4. 「目标完成时间」请填写具体日期，格式如 2026-06-30。",
    "5. 无法按期完成的事项，请在「备注」中说明原因及需要的支持。",
    "6. 填写完成后请于 ____年__月__日 前回传至筹备组（联系人：________，电话：________）。",
]
for n in notes:
    ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=1, end_row=r, end_column=4)
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=n)
    c.font = BODY_FONT; c.alignment = WRAP; c.border = BORDER
    ws.row_dimensions[r].height = 20
    r += 1
r += 1
r = section(ws, r, 4, "二、表格分工表（筹备组下发前填写负责人）")
r = write_header(ws, r, ["工作表", "建议负责部门", "负责人（姓名）", "计划回传时间"])
duty = [
    ("01 项目基本信息", "筹备组/总经办", "", ""),
    ("02 证照与资质", "行政/总经办", "", ""),
    ("03 人力资源", "人事部", "", ""),
    ("04 客房与房价", "客房部+前厅部", "", ""),
    ("05 IT与系统", "IT/工程部", "", ""),
    ("06 采购与供应商", "采购/财务部", "", ""),
    ("07 餐饮筹备", "餐饮部（无餐饮可删除）", "", ""),
    ("08 市场营销", "市场销售部", "", ""),
    ("09 财务与保险", "财务部", "", ""),
    ("10 工程与安全", "工程部/保安部", "", ""),
    ("11 关键里程碑", "筹备组汇总", "", ""),
]
r = write_rows(ws, r, duty)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
page_setup(ws, landscape=False)

CHK8 = ["序号", "事项/证照名称", "具体内容或要求", "负责部门", "负责人", "目标完成时间", "当前状态", "备注"]
W8 = [6, 24, 42, 11, 10, 13, 10, 18]

def add_check_sheet(name, items, cols=None, widths=None, tab="1F4E79"):
    ws = wb.create_sheet(name)
    ws.sheet_properties.tabColor = tab
    cols = cols or CHK8
    widths = widths or W8
    set_widths(ws, widths)
    r = sheet_title(ws, len(cols), name.split(" ", 1)[1] if " " in name else name)
    r = write_header(ws, r, cols)
    start = r
    rows = []
    for i, (item, detail) in enumerate(items, start=1):
        row = [i, item, detail] + [""] * (len(cols) - 3)
        rows.append(row)
    r = write_rows(ws, r, rows)
    end = r - 1
    ws.freeze_panes = f"A{start}"
    page_setup(ws)
    return ws, start, end

# ============ 01 项目基本信息 ============
ws, s, e = add_check_sheet("01 项目基本信息", [], widths=[6, 28, 46, 20])
cols = ["序号", "收集项", "填写内容（请如实填写）", "备注"]
# 重建表头（覆盖默认8列）
ws.delete_rows(2, e - s + 1)
r = write_header(ws, 2, cols)
info = [
    ("酒店全称（营业执照名称）", ""), ("对外经营名称/品牌", ""),
    ("品牌/管理公司（如有）", ""), ("酒店详细地址", ""),
    ("物业权属（自有/租赁，租期）", ""), ("酒店定位（星级/档次/类型）", ""),
    ("总建筑面积（㎡）", ""), ("楼层分布（地上/地下层数）", ""),
    ("客房总数（间/套）", ""), ("餐厅数量与总餐位数", ""),
    ("会议室/宴会厅数量与面积", ""), ("停车位数量", ""),
    ("计划试营业日期", ""), ("计划正式开业日期", ""),
    ("总经理/筹备负责人及电话", ""), ("填报人及日期", ""),
]
rows = [[i, k, "", ""] for i, (k, _) in enumerate(info, 1)]
r = write_rows(ws, r, rows)
add_dv(ws, "C", 3, r - 1, "请选择填写,已填写") if False else None
ws.freeze_panes = "A3"; page_setup(ws, landscape=False)

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Minimal OOXML xlsx writer: styles, merges, freeze, autofilter, data validation, formulas."""
import zipfile, re

def esc(s):
    s = str(s)
    s = s.replace('&', '&').replace('<', '<').replace('>', '>')
    return s.replace('"', '"')

def col_letter(i):
    s = ''
    while i > 0:
        i, r = divmod(i - 1, 26)
        s = chr(65 + r) + s
    return s

FONTS = [
    '<font><sz val="11"/><color rgb="FF222222"/><name val="Microsoft YaHei"/><charset val="134"/></font>',
    '<font><b/><sz val="16"/><color rgb="FFFFFFFF"/><name val="Microsoft YaHei"/><charset val="134"/></font>',

    '<font><sz val="10.5"/><color rgb="FF222222"/><name val="Microsoft YaHei"/><charset val="134"/></font>',
    '<font><b/><sz val="10.5"/><color rgb="FF1F4E79"/><name val="Microsoft YaHei"/><charset val="134"/></font>',

    '<font><sz val="10.5"/><color rgb="FF9A9A9A"/><name val="Microsoft YaHei"/><charset val="134"/></font>',
    '<font><b/><sz val="10"/><color rgb="FF222222"/><name val="Microsoft YaHei"/><charset val="134"/></font>',
    '<font><sz val="10"/><color rgb="FF222222"/><name val="Microsoft YaHei"/><charset val="134"/></font>',
    '<font><b/><sz val="12"/><color rgb="FF1F4E79"/><name val="Microsoft YaHei"/><charset val="134"/></font>',
]
FILLS = ['<fill><patternFill patternType="none"/></fill>',
         '<fill><patternFill patternType="gray125"/></fill>',
         '<fill><patternFill patternType="solid"><fgColor rgb="FF1F4E79"/><bgColor indexed="64"/></patternFill></fill>',
         '<fill><patternFill patternType="solid"><fgColor rgb="FF2E75B6"/><bgColor indexed="64"/></patternFill></fill>',
         '<fill><patternFill patternType="solid"><fgColor rgb="FFDDEBF7"/><bgColor indexed="64"/></patternFill></fill>',
         '<fill><patternFill patternType="solid"><fgColor rgb="FFFDF0EF"/><bgColor indexed="64"/></patternFill></fill>',
         '<fill><patternFill patternType="solid"><fgColor rgb="FFFFFFFF"/><bgColor indexed="64"/></patternFill></fill>',
         '<fill><patternFill patternType="solid"><fgColor rgb="FFF7F9FC"/><bgColor indexed="64"/></patternFill></fill>']
BD = '<left style="thin"><color rgb="FFC9D6E4"/></left><right style="thin"><color rgb="FFC9D6E4"/></right><top style="thin"><color rgb="FFC9D6E4"/></top><bottom style="thin"><color rgb="FFC9D6E4"/></bottom>'
BORDERS = ['<border><left/><right/><top/><bottom/><diagonal/></border>',
           '<border>' + BD + '<diagonal/></border>']

def _align(h=None, v='center', wrap=None):
    a = '<alignment'
    if h: a += ' horizontal="%s"' % h
    if v: a += ' vertical="%s"' % v
    if wrap: a += ' wrapText="1"'
    return a + '/>'

# xf index -> (font, fill, border, align, numFmt)
XFS = [
    (0, 0, 0, None, 0),               # 0 default
    (1, 2, 0, _align('center'), 0),   # 1 title
    (2, 0, 0, _align('left'), 0),     # 2 subtitle
    (3, 3, 1, _align('center', 'center', 1), 0),   # 3 header
    (4, 6, 1, _align('center', 'center', 1), 0),   # 4 serial
    (4, 6, 1, _align('left', 'center', 1), 0),     # 5 text
    (6, 5, 1, _align('center', 'center', 1), 0),   # 6 required tag
    (7, 6, 1, _align('center', 'center', 1), 0),   # 7 optional tag
    (9, 6, 1, _align('center', 'center', 1), 0),   # 8 dept
    (9, 7, 1, _align('center', 'center', 1), 0),   # 9 status(input)
    (9, 6, 1, _align('left', 'center', 1), 0),     # 10 note
    (8, 4, 1, _align('left', 'center'), 0),        # 11 band
    (9, 6, 1, _align('center', 'center'), 0),      # 12 number
    (8, 6, 1, _align('center', 'center'), 1),      # 13 percent (numFmt 10)
    (8, 6, 1, _align('center', 'center', 1), 0),   # 14 bold center
    (9, 6, 0, _align('left', 'top', 1), 0),        # 15 free text
    (10, 0, 0, _align('left', 'center'), 0),       # 16 h2
    (8, 4, 1, _align('center', 'center', 1), 0),   # 17 label
    (9, 6, 1, _align('center', 'center', 1), 0),   # 18 input wide
]
STYLES = {'default':0,'title':1,'subtitle':2,'header':3,'serial':4,'text':5,'req':6,'opt':7,'dept':8,
          'status':9,'note':10,'band':11,'num':12,'pct':13,'bcenter':14,'free':15,'h2':16,'label':17,'input':18}

class Sheet:
    def __init__(self, name, widths, freeze=None):
        self.name = name
        self.widths = widths          # list of floats
        self.rows = []                # (rownum, height or None, [cells], outline)
        self.merges = []
        self.freeze = freeze          # top-left cell, e.g. 'A4'
        self.autofilter = None
        self.dv = []                  # (sqref, list-of-values)
        self.landscape = True

    def add_row(self, cells, height=None):
        self.rows.append((None, height, cells, None))

    def cell(self, col, val, style=None, typ=None):
        return (col, val, style, typ)

    # ---- build ----
    def _row_xml(self, r, height, cells):
        attrs = ' r="%d"' % r
        if height:
            attrs += ' ht="%s" customHeight="1"' % height
        parts = []
        for (c, v, s, t) in cells:
            if v is None or v == '':
                parts.append('<c r="%s%d" s="%d"/>' % (col_letter(c), r, s if s is not None else 0))
            elif t == 'f':
                parts.append('<c r="%s%d" s="%d"><f>%s</f></c>' % (col_letter(c), r, s, esc(v)))
            elif t == 'n':
                parts.append('<c r="%s%d" s="%d"><v>%s</v></c>' % (col_letter(c), r, s, v))
            else:
                parts.append('<c r="%s%d" s="%d" t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">%s</t></is></c>'
                             % (col_letter(c), r, s, esc(v)))
        return '<row%s>%s</row>' % (attrs, ''.join(parts))

    def xml(self, rid):
        out = ['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>',
               '<worksheet xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main" '
               'xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships">']
        out.append('<sheetPr><pageSetUpPr fitToPage="1"/></sheetPr>')
        maxc = len(self.widths)
        last = col_letter(maxc)
        out.append('<dimension ref="A1:%s%d"/>' % (last, len(self.rows)))
        pane = ''
        if self.freeze:
            out.append('<sheetViews><sheetView workbookViewId="0"%s><pane xSplit="0" ySplit="%d" topLeftCell="%s" '
                       'activePane="bottomLeft" state="frozen"/><selection pane="bottomLeft" activeCell="%s" sqref="%s"/>'
                       '</sheetView></sheetViews>' % (' tabSelected="1"' if rid == 1 else '',
                                                      int(re.sub(r'\D', '', self.freeze)) - 1,
                                                      self.freeze, self.freeze, self.freeze))
        else:
            out.append('<sheetViews><sheetView workbookViewId="0"%s><selection activeCell="A1" sqref="A1"/>'
                       '</sheetView></sheetViews>' % (' tabSelected="1"' if rid == 1 else ''))
        out.append('<sheetFormatPr defaultRowHeight="18" defaultColWidth="9"/>')
        cols = []
        for i, w in enumerate(self.widths, start=1):
            cols.append('<col min="%d" max="%d" width="%s" customWidth="1"/>' % (i, i, w))
        out.append('<cols>%s</cols>' % ''.join(cols))
        out.append('<sheetData>')
        for idx, (_, h, cells, _o) in enumerate(self.rows, start=1):
            out.append(self._row_xml(idx, h, cells))
        out.append('</sheetData>')
        if self.autofilter:
            out.append('<autoFilter ref="%s"/>' % self.autofilter)
        if self.merges:
            out.append('<mergeCells count="%d">%s</mergeCells>'
                       % (len(self.merges), ''.join('<mergeCell ref="%s"/>' % m for m in self.merges)))
        if self.dv:
            dv = []
            for ref, vals in self.dv:
                dv.append('<dataValidation type="list" allowBlank="1" showInputMessage="1" showErrorMessage="1" '
                          'errorTitle="请输入选项" error="请从下拉列表中选择" sqref="%s"><formula1>"%s"</formula1>'
                          '</dataValidation>' % (ref, ','.join(vals)))
            out.append('<dataValidations count="%d">%s</dataValidations>' % (len(dv), ''.join(dv)))
        out.append('<pageMargins left="0.4" right="0.4" top="0.5" bottom="0.5" header="0.3" footer="0.3"/>')
        out.append('<pageSetup paperSize="9" orientation="%s" fitToWidth="1" fitToHeight="0"/>'
                   % ('landscape' if self.landscape else 'portrait'))
        out.append('</worksheet>')
        return ''.join(out)

CT = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>'
      '<Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types">'
      '<Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/>'
      '<Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/>'
      '<Override PartName="/xl/workbook.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet.main+xml"/>'
      '%s<Override PartName="/xl/styles.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.styles+xml"/>'
      '</Types>')
RELS = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>'
        '<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">'
        '<Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" Target="xl/workbook.xml"/>'
        '</Relationships>')

def styles_xml():
    xfs = []
    for (f, fl, b, a, nf) in XFS:
        xfs.append('<xf numFmtId="%d" fontId="%d" fillId="%d" borderId="%d" xfId="0"%s%s>%s</xf>'

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Minimal OOXML xlsx writer: styles, merges, freeze, autofilter, data validation, formulas."""
import zipfile, re

def esc(s):
    s = str(s).replace('&', '&').replace('<', '<').replace('>', '>')
    return s.replace('"', '"')

def col_letter(i):
    s = ''
    while i > 0:
        i, r = divmod(i - 1, 26)
        s = chr(65 + r) + s
    return s

FONTS = [
    '<font><sz val="11"/><color rgb="FF222222"/><name val="Microsoft YaHei"/><charset val="134"/></font>',
    '<font><b/><sz val="16"/><color rgb="FFFFFFFF"/><name val="Microsoft YaHei"/><charset val="134"/></font>',
    '<font><i/><sz val="9"/><color rgb="FF808080"/><name val="Microsoft YaHei"/><charset val="134"/></font>',
    '<font><b/><sz val="10.5"/><color rgb="FFFFFFFF"/><name val="Microsoft YaHei"/><charset val="134"/></font>',
    '<font><sz val="10.5"/><color rgb="FF222222"/><name val="Microsoft YaHei"/><charset val="134"/></font>',

    '<font><b/><sz val="10"/><color rgb="FF222222"/><name val="Microsoft YaHei"/><charset val="134"/></font>',
    '<font><sz val="10"/><color rgb="FF222222"/><name val="Microsoft YaHei"/><charset val="134"/></font>',
    '<font><b/><sz val="12"/><color rgb="FF1F4E79"/><name val="Microsoft YaHei"/><charset val="134"/></font>',
]
FILLS = ['<fill><patternFill patternType="none"/></fill>',
         '<fill><patternFill patternType="gray125"/></fill>',
         '<fill><patternFill patternType="solid"><fgColor rgb="FF1F4E79"/><bgColor indexed="64"/></patternFill></fill>',
         '<fill><patternFill patternType="solid"><fgColor rgb="FF2E75B6"/><bgColor indexed="64"/></patternFill></fill>',
         '<fill><patternFill patternType="solid"><fgColor rgb="FFDDEBF7"/><bgColor indexed="64"/></patternFill></fill>',
         '<fill><patternFill patternType="solid"><fgColor rgb="FFFDF0EF"/><bgColor indexed="64"/></patternFill></fill>',
         '<fill><patternFill patternType="solid"><fgColor rgb="FFFFFFFF"/><bgColor indexed="64"/></patternFill></fill>',
         '<fill><patternFill patternType="solid"><fgColor rgb="FFF7F9FC"/><bgColor indexed="64"/></patternFill></fill>']
BD = ('<left style="thin"><color rgb="FFC9D6E4"/></left><right style="thin"><color rgb="FFC9D6E4"/></right>'
      '<top style="thin"><color rgb="FFC9D6E4"/></top><bottom style="thin"><color rgb="FFC9D6E4"/></bottom>')
BORDERS = ['<border><left/><right/><top/><bottom/><diagonal/></border>',
           '<border>' + BD + '<diagonal/></border>']

def _align(h=None, v='center', wrap=None):
    a = '<alignment'
    if h: a += ' horizontal="%s"' % h
    if v: a += ' vertical="%s"' % v
    if wrap: a += ' wrapText="1"'
    return a + '/>'

# (font, fill, border, align, numFmt)
XFS = [(0, 0, 0, None, 0),
       (1, 2, 0, _align('center'), 0),                      # 1 title
       (2, 0, 0, _align('left'), 0),                        # 2 subtitle
       (3, 3, 1, _align('center', 'center', 1), 0),         # 3 header
       (4, 6, 1, _align('center', 'center', 1), 0),         # 4 serial
       (4, 6, 1, _align('left', 'center', 1), 0),           # 5 text
       (6, 5, 1, _align('center', 'center', 1), 0),         # 6 required
       (7, 6, 1, _align('center', 'center', 1), 0),         # 7 optional
       (9, 6, 1, _align('center', 'center', 1), 0),         # 8 dept
       (9, 7, 1, _align('center', 'center', 1), 0),         # 9 status
       (9, 6, 1, _align('left', 'center', 1), 0),           # 10 note
       (8, 4, 1, _align('left', 'center'), 0),              # 11 band
       (9, 6, 1, _align('center', 'center'), 0),            # 12 number
       (8, 6, 1, _align('center', 'center'), 164),          # 13 percent
       (8, 6, 1, _align('center', 'center', 1), 0),         # 14 bold center
       (9, 6, 0, _align('left', 'top', 1), 0),              # 15 free text
       (10, 0, 0, _align('left', 'center'), 0),             # 16 h2
       (8, 4, 1, _align('center', 'center', 1), 0),         # 17 label
       (9, 6, 1, _align('left', 'center', 1), 0)]           # 18 input wide
STYLES = {'default': 0, 'title': 1, 'subtitle': 2, 'header': 3, 'serial': 4, 'text': 5, 'req': 6,
          'opt': 7, 'dept': 8, 'status': 9, 'note': 10, 'band': 11, 'num': 12, 'pct': 13,
          'bcenter': 14, 'free': 15, 'h2': 16, 'label': 17, 'input': 18}

class Sheet:
    def __init__(self, name, widths, freeze=None, landscape=True):
        self.name, self.widths = name, widths
        self.rows, self.merges, self.dv = [], [], []
        self.freeze, self.autofilter, self.landscape = freeze, None, landscape

    def add_row(self, cells, height=None):
        self.rows.append((height, cells))

    def cell(self, col, val, style=None, typ=None):
        return (col, val, style, typ)

    def _row_xml(self, r, height, cells):
        attrs = ' r="%d"' % r
        if height:
            attrs += ' ht="%s" customHeight="1"' % height
        parts = []
        for (c, v, s, t) in cells:
            s = 0 if s is None else s
            ref = '%s%d' % (col_letter(c), r)
            if v is None or v == '':
                parts.append('<c r="%s" s="%d"/>' % (ref, s))
            elif t == 'f':
                parts.append('<c r="%s" s="%d"><f>%s</f></c>' % (ref, s, esc(v)))
            elif t == 'n':
                parts.append('<c r="%s" s="%d"><v>%s</v></c>' % (ref, s, v))
            else:
                parts.append('<c r="%s" s="%d" t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">%s</t></is></c>'
                             % (ref, s, esc(v)))
        return '<row%s>%s</row>' % (attrs, ''.join(parts))

    def xml(self, rid):
        sel = ' tabSelected="1"' if rid == 1 else ''
        out = ['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>',
               '<worksheet xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main" '
               'xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships">',
               '<sheetPr><pageSetUpPr fitToPage="1"/></sheetPr>',
               '<dimension ref="A1:%s%d"/>' % (col_letter(len(self.widths)), max(len(self.rows), 1))]
        if self.freeze:
            ys = int(re.sub(r'\D', '', self.freeze)) - 1
            out.append('<sheetViews><sheetView workbookViewId="0"%s><pane ySplit="%d" topLeftCell="%s" '
                       'activePane="bottomLeft" state="frozen"/><selection pane="bottomLeft" activeCell="%s" '
                       'sqref="%s"/></sheetView></sheetViews>' % (sel, ys, self.freeze, self.freeze, self.freeze))
        else:
            out.append('<sheetViews><sheetView workbookViewId="0"%s><selection activeCell="A1" sqref="A1"/>'
                       '</sheetView></sheetViews>' % sel)
        out.append('<sheetFormatPr defaultRowHeight="18" defaultColWidth="9"/>')
        out.append('<cols>%s</cols>' % ''.join(
            '<col min="%d" max="%d" width="%s" customWidth="1"/>' % (i, i, w)
            for i, w in enumerate(self.widths, start=1)))
        out.append('<sheetData>')
        for idx, (h, cells) in enumerate(self.rows, start=1):
            out.append(self._row_xml(idx, h, cells))
        out.append('</sheetData>')
        if self.autofilter:
            out.append('<autoFilter ref="%s"/>' % self.autofilter)
        if self.merges:
            out.append('<mergeCells count="%d">%s</mergeCells>'
                       % (len(self.merges), ''.join('<mergeCell ref="%s"/>' % m for m in self.merges)))
        if self.dv:
            out.append('<dataValidations count="%d">%s</dataValidations>' % (len(self.dv), ''.join(
                '<dataValidation type="list" allowBlank="1" showInputMessage="1" showErrorMessage="1" '
                'errorTitle="请选择" error="请从下拉列表中选择" sqref="%s"><formula1>"%s"</formula1>'
                '</dataValidation>' % (ref, ','.join(vals)) for ref, vals in self.dv)))
        out.append('<pageMargins left="0.4" right="0.4" top="0.5" bottom="0.5" header="0.3" footer="0.3"/>')
        out.append('<pageSetup paperSize="9" orientation="%s" fitToWidth="1" fitToHeight="0"/>'
                   % ('landscape' if self.landscape else 'portrait'))
        out.append('</worksheet>')
        return ''.join(out)

    for (f, fl, b, a, nf) in XFS:
        xfs.append('<xf numFmtId="%d" fontId="%d" fillId="%d" borderId="%d" xfId="0"%s%s>%s</xf>'
                   % (nf, f, fl, b, ' applyFont="1"' if f else '', ' applyFill="1"' if fl else '', a or ''))
    return ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>'
            '<styleSheet xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main">'
            '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0%"/></numFmts>'
            '<fonts count="%d">%s</fonts><fills count="%d">%s</fills><borders count="%d">%s</borders>'
            '<cellStyleXfs count="1"><xf numFmtId="0" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0"/></cellStyleXfs>'
            '<cellXfs count="%d">%s</cellXfs>'
            '<cellStyles count="1"><cellStyle name="Normal" xfId="0" builtinId="0"/></cellStyles>'
            '</styleSheet>') % (len(FONTS), ''.join(FONTS), len(FILLS), ''.join(FILLS),
                                len(BORDERS), ''.join(BORDERS), len(xfs), ''.join(xfs))

def save(path, sheets):
    n = len(sheets)
    ct = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>'
          '<Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types">'
          '<Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/>'
          '<Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/>'
          '<Override PartName="/xl/workbook.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet.main+xml"/>'
          '%s<Override PartName="/xl/styles.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.styles+xml"/>'
          '</Types>') % ''.join('<Override PartName="/xl/worksheets/sheet%d.xml" ContentType="application/'
                                'vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml"/>' % i
                                for i in range(1, n + 1))
    wb = ['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>',
          '<workbook xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main" '
          'xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships">',
          '<workbookPr/><sheets>']
    for i, s in enumerate(sheets, start=1):
        wb.append('<sheet name="%s" sheetId="%d" r:id="rId%d"/>' % (esc(s.name), i, i))
    wb.append('</sheets><calcPr calcId="191029" fullCalcOnLoad="1"/></workbook>')
    wbrels = ['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>',
              '<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">']
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        wbrels.append('<Relationship Id="rId%d" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/'

    wbrels.append('<Relationship Id="rId%d" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/'
                  'relationships/styles" Target="styles.xml"/>' % (n + 1))
    wbrels.append('</Relationships>')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        z.writestr('[Content_Types].xml', ct)
        z.writestr('_rels/.rels', RELS)

        z.writestr('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels', ''.join(wbrels))
        z.writestr('xl/styles.xml', styles_xml())
        for i, s in enumerate(sheets, start=1):
            z.writestr('xl/worksheets/sheet%d.xml' % i, s.xml(i))

        '<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">'

    wb = ['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>',
          '<workbook xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main" '
          'xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships">',
          '<workbookPr/><sheets>']
    for i, s in enumerate(sheets, start=1):
        wb.append('<sheet name="%s" sheetId="%d" r:id="rId%d"/>' % (esc(s.name), i, i))
    wb.append('</sheets><calcPr calcId="191029" fullCalcOnLoad="1"/></workbook>')
    wbrels = ['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>',
              '<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">']
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        wbrels.append('<Relationship Id="rId%d" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/'
                      'relationships/worksheet" Target="worksheets/sheet%d.xml"/>' % (i, i))
    wbrels.append('<Relationship Id="rId%d" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/'
                  'relationships/styles" Target="styles.xml"/>' % (n + 1))
    wbrels.append('</Relationships>')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        z.writestr('[Content_Types].xml', ct)
        z.writestr('_rels/.rels', RELS)
        z.writestr('xl/workbook.xml', ''.join(wb))
        z.writestr('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels', ''.join(wbrels))
        z.writestr('xl/styles.xml', styles_xml())

            z.writestr('xl/worksheets/sheet%d.xml' % i, s.xml(i))

    def _row_xml(self, r, height, cells):
        attrs = ' r="%d"' % r
        if height:
            attrs += ' ht="%s" customHeight="1"' % height
        parts = []
        for (c, v, s, t) in cells:
            s = 0 if s is None else s
            ref = '%s%d' % (col_letter(c), r)
            if v is None or v == '':
                parts.append('<c r="%s" s="%d"/>' % (ref, s))
            elif t == 'f':
                parts.append('<c r="%s" s="%d"><f>%s</f></c>' % (ref, s, esc(v)))
            elif t == 'n':
                parts.append('<c r="%s" s="%d"><v>%s</v></c>' % (ref, s, v))
            else:
                parts.append('<c r="%s" s="%d" t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">%s</t></is></c>'
                             % (ref, s, esc(v)))
        return '<row%s>%s</row>' % (attrs, ''.join(parts))

    def xml(self, rid):
        sel = ' tabSelected="1"' if rid == 1 else ''
        out = ['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>',
               '<worksheet xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main" '
               'xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships">',
               '<sheetPr><pageSetUpPr fitToPage="1"/></sheetPr>',
               '<dimension ref="A1:%s%d"/>' % (col_letter(len(self.widths)), max(len(self.rows), 1))]
        if self.freeze:
            ys = int(re.sub(r'\D', '', self.freeze)) - 1
            out.append('<sheetViews><sheetView workbookViewId="0"%s><pane ySplit="%d" topLeftCell="%s" '
                       'activePane="bottomLeft" state="frozen"/><selection pane="bottomLeft" activeCell="%s" '
                       'sqref="%s"/></sheetView></sheetViews>' % (sel, ys, self.freeze, self.freeze, self.freeze))
        else:
            out.append('<sheetViews><sheetView workbookViewId="0"%s><selection activeCell="A1" sqref="A1"/>'
                       '</sheetView></sheetViews>' % sel)
        out.append('<sheetFormatPr defaultRowHeight="18" defaultColWidth="9"/>')
        out.append('<cols>%s</cols>' % ''.join(
            '<col min="%d" max="%d" width="%s" customWidth="1"/>' % (i, i, w)
            for i, w in enumerate(self.widths, start=1)))
        out.append('<sheetData>')
        for idx, (h, cells) in enumerate(self.rows, start=1):
            out.append(self._row_xml(idx, h, cells))
        out.append('</sheetData>')
        if self.autofilter:
            out.append('<autoFilter ref="%s"/>' % self.autofilter)
        if self.merges:
            out.append('<mergeCells count="%d">%s</mergeCells>'
                       % (len(self.merges), ''.join('<mergeCell ref="%s"/>' % m for m in self.merges)))
        if self.dv:
            out.append('<dataValidations count="%d">%s</dataValidations>' % (len(self.dv), ''.join(
                '<dataValidation type="list" allowBlank="1" showInputMessage="1" showErrorMessage="1" '
                'errorTitle="请选择" error="请从下拉列表中选择" sqref="%s"><formula1>"%s"</formula1>'
                '</dataValidation>' % (ref, ','.join(vals)) for ref, vals in self.dv)))
        out.append('<pageMargins left="0.4" right="0.4" top="0.5" bottom="0.5" header="0.3" footer="0.3"/>')
        out.append('<pageSetup paperSize="9" orientation="%s" fitToWidth="1" fitToHeight="0"/>'
                   % ('landscape' if self.landscape else 'portrait'))
        out.append('</worksheet>')
        return ''.join(out)

def styles_xml():
    xfs = []
    for (f, fl, b, a, nf) in XFS:
        xfs.append('<xf numFmtId="%d" fontId="%d" fillId="%d" borderId="%d" xfId="0"%s%s>%s</xf>'
                   % (nf, f, fl, b, ' applyFont="1"' if f else '', ' applyFill="1"' if fl else '', a or ''))
    return ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>'
            '<styleSheet xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main">'
            '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0%"/></numFmts>'
            '<fonts count="%d">%s</fonts><fills count="%d">%s</fills><borders count="%d">%s</borders>'
            '<cellStyleXfs count="1"><xf numFmtId="0" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0"/></cellStyleXfs>'
            '<cellXfs count="%d">%s</cellXfs>'
            '<cellStyles count="1"><cellStyle name="Normal" xfId="0" builtinId="0"/></cellStyles>'
            '</styleSheet>') % (len(FONTS), ''.join(FONTS), len(FILLS), ''.join(FILLS),
                                len(BORDERS), ''.join(BORDERS), len(xfs), ''.join(xfs))

def save(path, sheets):
    n = len(sheets)
    ct = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>'
          '<Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types">'
          '<Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/>'
          '<Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/>'
          '<Override PartName="/xl/workbook.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet.main+xml"/>'
          '%s<Override PartName="/xl/styles.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.styles+xml"/>'
          '</Types>') % ''.join('<Override PartName="/xl/worksheets/sheet%d.xml" ContentType="application/'
                                'vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml"/>' % i
                                for i in range(1, n + 1))
    wb = ['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>',
          '<workbook xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main" '
          'xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships">',
          '<workbookPr/><sheets>']
    for i, s in enumerate(sheets, start=1):
        wb.append('<sheet name="%s" sheetId="%d" r:id="rId%d"/>' % (esc(s.name), i, i))
    wb.append('</sheets><calcPr calcId="191029" fullCalcOnLoad="1"/></workbook>')
    wbrels = ['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>',
              '<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">']
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        wbrels.append('<Relationship Id="rId%d" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/'
                      'relationships/worksheet" Target="worksheets/sheet%d.xml"/>' % (i, i))
    wbrels.append('<Relationship Id="rId%d" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/'
                  'relationships/styles" Target="styles.xml"/>' % (n + 1))
    wbrels.append('</Relationships>')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        z.writestr('[Content_Types].xml', ct)
        z.writestr('_rels/.rels', RELS)
        z.writestr('xl/workbook.xml', ''.join(wb))
        z.writestr('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels', ''.join(wbrels))
        z.writestr('xl/styles.xml', styles_xml())
        for i, s in enumerate(sheets, start=1):
            z.writestr('xl/worksheets/sheet%d.xml' % i, s.xml(i))

RELS = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>'
        '<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">'
        '<Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/'
        'officeDocument" Target="xl/workbook.xml"/></Relationships>')

    s = ""
    while n > 0:
        n, r = divmod(n - 1, 26)
        s = chr(65 + r) + s
    return s

    def __init__(self, name, tab_color="FF2F5597"):
        self.name = name
        self.tab_color = tab_color
        self.cells = {}
        self.merges = []
        self.widths = {}
        self.heights = {}
        self.freeze = None
        self.dv = []
        self.last_row = 1
        self.last_col = 1

    def cell(self, r, c, v="", style="bodyL"):

        self.last_row = max(self.last_row, r)
        self.last_col = max(self.last_col, c)
        return self

    def row(self, r, values, style="bodyL", styles=None):
        for i, v in enumerate(values, start=1):
            st = styles[i - 1] if styles else style
            self.cell(r, i, v, st)
        return self

    def merge(self, r1, c1, r2, c2):

        self.last_col = max(self.last_col, c2)
        return self

        return self

        return self

    def _sheet_xml(self):

               '<worksheet xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main" '
               'xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships">',

               '<dimension ref="A1:%s%d"/>' % (col_letter(self.last_col), self.last_row),
               '<sheetViews><sheetView showGridLines="0" workbookViewId="0">']
        if self.freeze:
            y, tl = self.freeze
            out.append('<pane ySplit="%d" topLeftCell="%s" activePane="bottomLeft" state="frozen"/>' % (y, tl))

        out.append('</sheetView></sheetViews>')
        out.append('<sheetFormatPr defaultRowHeight="17"/>')
        if self.widths:

            for c in sorted(self.widths):
                out.append('<col min="%d" max="%d" width="%s" customWidth="1"/>' % (c, c, self.widths[c]))
            out.append('</cols>')
        out.append('<sheetData>')
        rows = {}
        for (r, c), (text, s) in self.cells.items():
            rows.setdefault(r, {})[c] = (text, s)

            attr = ' ht="%s" customHeight="1"' % ht if ht else ""
            out.append('<row r="%d"%s>' % (r, attr))
            for c in sorted(rows[r]):

                if text == "":

        out.append('</sheetData>')

            for r1, c1, r2, c2 in self.merges:
                out.append('<mergeCell ref="%s%d:%s%d"/>' % (col_letter(c1), r1, col_letter(c2), r2))
            out.append('</mergeCells>')
        if self.dv:
            out.append('<dataValidations count="%d">' % len(self.dv))
            for ref, opts in self.dv:
                out.append('<dataValidation type="list" allowBlank="1" showInputMessage="1" '

                           % (ref, escape(",".join(opts))))
            out.append('</dataValidations>')
        out.append('<pageMargins left="0.4" right="0.4" top="0.5" bottom="0.5" header="0.3" footer="0.3"/>')
        out.append('<pageSetup paperSize="9" orientation="landscape" fitToWidth="1" fitToHeight="0"/>')
        out.append('</worksheet>')
        return "".join(out)


def _styles_xml():
    xfs = []
    for i in range(len(XF)):
        f, fl, b, ha, va, wrap = XF[i]
        al = ""
        if ha or va or wrap:
